fronts.v: Energy grid hit again: [[1 million+]] lose power, 8+ killed, officials say
IRGC says Hormuz is [["closed"]] as tankers reported hit
UNICEF: [[340+ children]] killed since the ceasefire
Nyala market strike: RSF says [[30 killed]], army disputes

slides.sources: Sources: Al Jazeera/Reuters, UN News, UNICEF, UKMTO, AFP, Times of Israel

slides.headline: Power cut to [[1 million+.]] Malls hit.
bullets: **Overnight into Oct 16:** Russian attacks killed at least **8** and injured **60** across nine regions, Ukrainian officials say (Al Jazeera/Reuters).
**Shopping centres** hit in Rivne and Sumy; drones set ~10 trucks ablaze at a customs terminal in Kovel.
**Grid:** Ukraine's energy ministry says power was restored to 1M+ people. In Volyn, ~370,000 households lost supply.
**Moscow:** Russia's military chief told Putin the assets for the energy campaign are in place (as reported). No Russian comment on the strikes found.
slides.sources: Sources: Al Jazeera citing Reuters (Oct 17). Casualty figures are from Ukrainian officials, not independently verified.

slides.headline: Today in [[4 numbers]]

stats.l: Civilians killed in Ukraine in September, 85% more than Sept 2025
stats.s: UN human rights monitors via Al Jazeera

stats.l: People in Yemen cut off from aid by fighting, per WFP
Children killed in Gaza since the ceasefire, UNICEF says
Killed in Nyala market strike, per RSF (claim). Army says it killed dozens of RSF fighters

slides.sources: Sources: UN News, Al Jazeera/AFP. Nyala accounts conflict and are unverified.

slides.headline: "Closed." [[Tankers hit.]]
bullets: **Hormuz (Oct 17):** the IRGC navy says the strait is "closed." UKMTO says a tanker was hit by an RPG from a small boat; three tankers reported hit, per social media (Al Jazeera).
**US:** Trump claims the blockade has stopped all Iranian ships transiting. Unconfirmed.
**Aden (Oct 16):** Yemen's government says the Houthis fired two missiles near the airport. The Houthis say they targeted a Saudi command post.
**Saudi:** coalition claims it downed missiles over Riyadh.
slides.sources: Sources: Al Jazeera, AFP, UKMTO, WFP. IRGC, Houthi, coalition and Trump statements are claims.

slides.headline: [[340+ children]] dead since the truce
bullets: **UNICEF (Oct 16):** 340+ children killed since the ceasefire; 7 killed, 33 seriously hurt in the past two weeks. ~800,000 children displaced.
**Gaza (Oct 17):** one Palestinian reportedly killed near a Gaza City school. The IDF says it killed two Hamas operatives (Times of Israel).
**West Bank:** a US journalist was hurt in a settler attack in Abu Falah, reports say. Israel votes Oct 27.
slides.sources: Sources: UN News/UNICEF (Oct 16), Times of Israel (Oct 16-17). IDF statements are claims.

slides.headline: Market hit. [[Two accounts.]]
bullets: **Nyala (Oct 16):** the RSF says an army drone hit a livestock market, killing **30 civilians** incl. 17 women and 5 children. The army says it killed dozens of RSF fighters in air strikes on RSF positions.
**Emergency Lawyers** say a Nyala market was hit by an army-linked drone. Neither side's account is verified (AFP via Al Jazeera).
**UN (Oct 16):** 20M people face acute hunger, 200,000 at catastrophe levels. A drone strike near the Ethiopian border killed 41 displaced people on Oct 10.
slides.sources: Sources: Al Jazeera/AFP (Oct 17), UN News (Oct 16). RSF and army statements are claims.

slides.headline: This [[week]]
bullets: **Ukraine:** more grid strikes; winter blackouts as the UN calls October among the deadliest in years.
**Hormuz:** whether more tankers are hit after the IRGC's "closed" warning; US blockade claims.
**Yemen/Saudi:** Houthi fire at Aden and Riyadh; aid access to Taiz.
**Israel:** election Oct 27; Gaza winter shelter crisis.

caption_facebook:
WORLD AT WAR: Saturday, Oct 17, 2026
4 fronts, 24 hours. Here's what changed.

🇺🇦 UKRAINE (Day 1,697)
• Russian attacks killed at least 8 and injured 60 across nine regions, Ukrainian officials say (Al Jazeera/Reuters). Shopping centres were hit in Rivne and Sumy; drones torched ~10 trucks at a customs terminal in Kovel.
• Ukraine's energy ministry says power was restored to 1M+ people. About 370,000 households in Volyn lost supply.
• UN monitors: 328 civilians killed in September (85% more than Sept 2025); 2,570 killed Jan-Sept.

🇮🇷 IRAN WAR (Day 232)
• The IRGC navy says the Strait of Hormuz is "closed" and claims one tanker was on an "unauthorised" route. UKMTO says a tanker was hit by an RPG fired from a small boat. Three tankers reported hit, per social media (Al Jazeera).
• Trump claims the US blockade has stopped all Iranian ships from transiting; unconfirmed.
• Yemen's government says the Houthis fired two missiles near Aden airport; the Houthis say they targeted a Saudi command post. The coalition says it downed missiles and drones over Riyadh.
• WFP: fighting has cut aid to ~800,000 people in Yemen, including 600,000+ in Taiz.

🇵🇸 GAZA / WEST BANK
• UNICEF: 340+ children killed since the ceasefire; ~800,000 children displaced.
• Times of Israel: one Palestinian reportedly killed near a Gaza City school; the IDF says it killed two Hamas operatives. A US journalist was hurt in a settler attack in Abu Falah. Israel votes Oct 27.

🇸🇩 SUDAN
• The RSF says an army drone killed 30 civilians in a Nyala livestock market. The army says it killed dozens of RSF fighters in air strikes. Neither is verified (AFP via Al Jazeera).
• UN: 20M face acute hunger; a drone strike near the Ethiopian border killed 41 displaced people on Oct 10.

Sources: Al Jazeera/Reuters/AFP, UN News, UNICEF, WFP, UKMTO, Times of Israel. Warring-party claims are unverified.
